title: Scalar compatibility of the etale sum-extension counit
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes below are separated and finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On small ordinary etale sites use constant-ring module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and $T_T=(-)_B=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $D^b_{ctf}$ for bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude, as in [det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer], and $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ for $R=A,B$ [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. Let $e:U\to V$ be separated etale of finite type. Write $E_R=De_{\Sigma!,R}$ for exact sum extension and $E_R\dashv e_R^*$ for its derived adjunction, with sum/evaluation counit $v_R$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension, lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality]. Let $\sigma_e:T_VE_A\xrightarrow{\sim}E_BT_U$ be the summandwise tensor comparison on K-flat representatives [lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility], and $a_e:T_Ue_A^*\xrightarrow{\sim}e_B^*T_V$ the canonical pullback/tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(V_{et},A)$ one has
$$v_{B,T_VK}\,E_B(a_e(K))\,\sigma_e(e_A^*K)=T_V(v_{A,K}).$$
Thus $a_e$ is the mate of $\sigma_e^{-1}$. For a chosen compactification of $e$, the same assertion holds with the compact-support coefficient map and its counit after the counit-preserving normalization [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization].
